correctness.rationale: The residue-unit character group modulo T² is F_q^××F_q via (f(0),f'(0)/f(0)); degree≥2 coefficients of nontrivial additive-character L-series vanish, while mixed Gauss sums have squared modulus 1 or q. Unique squarefree-times-square factorization proves the exact quotient L_{η,ψ}(z)/L_{η²,ψ²}(z²). Parseval then gives ((q−3)q^ceil(n/2)+q+1)/q in both parities. The quadratic character is separately handled. For q=3, the six Fourier-inverted class counts differ by ≤1; for q≥5,n≥3 the variance exceeds M/4, impossible if all integers differ by ≤1. The n=2 case is a zero/one squarefree indicator. Independent direct polynomial gcd enumeration checked q=3 degrees 2..6, q=5 degrees 2..4, q=7 degrees 2..3. This checks finite examples, not the infinite proof.
